title: Which Language Should a Classroom Use?
title_ja: 教室ではどの言語で学ぶべきか

source_links.title: UNESCO: Languages Matter — Global Guidance on Multilingual Education

fact_notes: 背景となる考え方は添付の資料で確認。本文と練習問題は新規制作。例示した人物・学校・活動は架空の説明用設定。

sentences.en: On the first day of a science course, students in a multilingual classroom receive a textbook written in the country's official language.
sentences.ja: 多言語の教室で理科の授業初日、生徒は国の公用語で書かれた教科書を受け取ります。

sentences.en: Some children read the instructions easily, while others understand the scientific ideas but struggle with the language used to explain them.
sentences.ja: 説明を容易に読める子どももいれば、科学的な考えは理解していても説明の言語に苦労する子どももいます。

sentences.en: A teacher might conclude that students who answer slowly have not understood the lesson.
sentences.ja: 教師は回答の遅い生徒が授業内容を理解していないと判断するかもしれません。

sentences.en: However, difficulty expressing an answer does not necessarily mean difficulty understanding the underlying concept.
sentences.ja: しかし答えを表現する難しさが必ずしも基になる概念の理解不足を意味するわけではありません。

sentences.en: The distinction is especially important when a school serves families with several home languages.
sentences.ja: この違いは複数の家庭言語を持つ家族が通う学校で特に重要です。

sentences.en: A fair assessment must consider whether it is measuring scientific knowledge, language ability, or an uncertain mixture of both.
sentences.ja: 公正な評価では科学知識、言語能力、それらの不明確な混合の何を測っているか考える必要があります。

sentences.en: UNESCO guidance recognizes that education in languages learners understand can support inclusion and meaningful learning.
sentences.ja: ユネスコの指針は、学習者が理解する言語での教育が包摂と意味ある学びを支えると認めています。

sentences.en: For example, discussing a new concept first in a familiar language may allow students to connect it with experiences at home.
sentences.ja: 例えば新しい概念をまずなじみのある言語で議論すると、家庭での経験と結びつけられるかもしれません。

sentences.en: A student who understands how plants respond to sunlight can then learn the technical terms in another language.
sentences.ja: 植物が日光にどう反応するか理解した生徒は、その後別の言語で専門用語を学べます。

sentences.en: This approach does not require schools to abandon the national language or international communication.
sentences.ja: この方法は国語や国際的な意思疎通を学校が捨てることを求めません。

sentences.en: Instead, it treats existing language knowledge as a resource for developing additional abilities.
sentences.ja: むしろ既存の言語知識を追加の力を育てる資源として扱います。

sentences.en: Learning more than one language can become an advantage when students are given appropriate opportunities to use each one.
sentences.ja: 適切にそれぞれの言語を使う機会が与えられれば、複数の言語を学ぶことは利点になり得ます。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, creating a multilingual program involves practical decisions that cannot be solved by enthusiasm alone.
sentences.ja: それでも多言語のプログラムを作るには熱意だけでは解決できない実際的な判断が必要です。

sentences.en: A school may have students who speak many languages but only a limited number of teachers trained to teach through them.
sentences.ja: 生徒が多様な言語を話しても、それらを使って教えられる教師は限られているかもしれません。

sentences.en: Textbooks, examinations, and digital materials may be available in some languages but not in others.
sentences.ja: 教科書、試験、デジタル教材は一部の言語で入手できても他ではできない場合があります。

sentences.en: In addition, parents may disagree about how much classroom time should be devoted to each language.
sentences.ja: さらに各言語にどのくらい授業時間を割くべきか保護者の意見が異なるかもしれません。

sentences.en: Ignoring these constraints can produce a policy that sounds inclusive on paper yet is difficult to deliver consistently.
sentences.ja: こうした制約を無視すると、書面では包摂的に見えても一貫して実施しにくい方針になる場合があります。

sentences.en: Implementation therefore requires training, careful planning, and consultation with the communities whose children will be affected.
sentences.ja: 実施には研修、慎重な計画、影響を受ける子どもの地域社会との協議が必要です。

sentences.en: A school that wishes to improve its language policy could begin with a modest investigation rather than immediate reform.
sentences.ja: 言語方針を改善したい学校は、即座の改革でなく控えめな調査から始められます。

sentences.en: Teachers could compare how well students explain the same scientific idea under different, supportive language conditions.
sentences.ja: 教師は異なる支援的な言語条件下で生徒が同じ科学概念をどれだけ説明できるか比較できます。

sentences.en: They should avoid interpreting every higher score as proof that one language is always the best medium for every learner.
sentences.ja: 高い点数が出るたび一つの言語がすべての学習者に最良だという証明とみなすべきではありません。

sentences.en: Students may differ in reading experience, confidence, and the amount of academic vocabulary they know.
sentences.ja: 生徒は読書経験、自信、学術語彙の量が異なる場合があります。

sentences.en: Research should therefore describe who participated and what support was offered before drawing general conclusions.
sentences.ja: 研究は一般化する前に誰が参加しどんな支援が与えられたか示すべきです。

sentences.en: A careful school asks not simply which language is best but which combination of supports makes learning possible.
sentences.ja: 慎重な学校は最良の言語だけでなく、どんな支援の組み合わせが学びを可能にするか問います。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarizes the passage?
options: Students should abandon every home language.
Multilingual education can support learning but requires attention to assessment, resources, and local needs.
Science can only be taught in one language.
Every classroom should use an identical language policy.
questions.explanation_ja: 理解できる言語による学びと実施条件を総合的に論じています。

questions.prompt: What problem appears in the opening classroom?
options: Some learners know scientific ideas but struggle to express them in the classroom language.
questions.explanation_ja: 内容理解と言語的表現の差が示されています。

questions.prompt: Why can a slow answer be misleading evidence?
options: Language difficulty may be mistaken for weak subject understanding.
Students never use a home language.
questions.explanation_ja: 説明に使う言語の問題を内容理解不足と混同するためです。

questions.prompt: What approach does UNESCO's guidance support?
questions.explanation_ja: 学習者にわかる言語での教育の意義を説明しています。

questions.prompt: What may be learned after discussing a concept in a familiar language?
options: Only how to memorize a school timetable.
The price of a new dictionary.
A different school subject with no connection.
questions.explanation_ja: なじみの言語で概念理解後、別言語の専門用語を学べます。

options: Parents always agree on teaching methods.
Teacher preparation and materials may be limited.
questions.explanation_ja: 教師・教材・合意形成に実務的な制約があるためです。
implementationは計画を実行することです。

questions.prompt: What should a school consider when studying language support?
options: Only the total number of classrooms.
Students' confidence, reading experience, and academic vocabulary.
questions.explanation_ja: 自信・読書経験・学術語彙の違いを考慮します。

questions.prompt: Why is one high test score not sufficient proof of the best policy?
options: Different students and conditions may produce different results.
No one can compare teaching methods.
A language must be used by everyone.
questions.explanation_ja: 条件や学習者が異なれば結果も変わり得るからです。

questions.prompt: What does the final sentence emphasize?
options: All classes must abandon their curriculum.
The aim should be effective combinations of language and learning support.
One perfect language exists for every student.
questions.explanation_ja: 一つの言語選択より適切な支援の組み合わせが大切という結論です。

grammar.focus: does not necessarily mean difficulty understanding the underlying concept
grammar.explanation_ja: not necessarilyは部分否定で、表現上の問題と理解を区別します。

grammar.focus: who understands how plants respond to sunlight
grammar.explanation_ja: 関係代名詞whoと間接疑問how節を含みます。

grammar.focus: that sounds inclusive on paper yet is difficult to deliver consistently
grammar.explanation_ja: 関係代名詞thatがpolicyを修飾し、yetが対比を示します。
before＋動名詞で一般化前に必要な行動を示します。
